title: Fix SplitThinking bug reintroduced in OpenAICompatibleChatProvider
description:
## Source
Audit swarm finding F-AG5-04 / F39 (memorysmith-standards-spec-review-26-07-15-11-56-27)

## Problem
`OpenAICompatibleChatProvider.SplitThinking` uses `.Match()` (singular) instead of `.Matches()` (plural). Multi-block `<think>` responses silently discard all but the first block from the reasoning trace. The same bug was already fixed in `ChatServices.cs` (line 942) but the fix was never ported to the OpenAI-compatible provider's copy.

## Severity
**High** — multi-block thinking responses lose content silently

## Files
- `Agent.Planning/Llm/OpenAICompatibleChatProvider.cs` line 688
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/ChatServices.cs` line 942 (correct version)

## Recommendation
Change to `.Matches()` and aggregate all blocks. Extract shared `SplitThinking` helper to prevent recurrence.

Effort: 1-2 hours + test.

## Existing Coverage
No existing task.
